title: Venice gives 25-minute ovation for film on Israel's mass killing of Gaza civilians
summary: Mass civilian deaths were routinely built into Israeli military targeting decisions in Gaza, according to a Venice Film Festival documentary unveiled on Thursday that challenges official accounts of the war.
